span.p:
AUX-LOSS-FREE BALANCING
per-expert bias b_e updated each step
no competing gradient
critical: 5S rRNA is 5976 of 3D clusters,
an aux loss would fight the biology

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY ROUTE ON STRUCTURE
measured: GNRA k-mer context predicts
rigidity at only 0.073 sigma = negligible.
Routing on family would collapse onto rRNA.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY THE DEPTH GATE - MEASURED
APC-corrected MI vs curated base pairs,
12 Rfam seed alignments:
Neff/L >= 1 (n=2): precision 0.975
Neff/L < 1 (n=10): precision 0.609
tRNA at Neff/L=3.5 scores 1.000 / 1.000
Coevolution is near-sufficient when deep and
materially weaker when shallow. The correct
expert depends on an OBSERVABLE property of
the input - which is what MoE is actually for.
